Verbal communication will always be Human Beings' primary method of communication due to our possession and mastery of vocal cords and ear drums. Verbal communication is also the most efficient method of communication is it allows for the receiver (person whom you are communicating with to provide immediate feedback to your encoded message (words). Memes are a great form of communication but I would personally place them just below the efficiency of non-verbal communication and written language. Memes portray an idea through pictures, color, text, etc... much in the same way art, the painted or drawn picture, can (and I'm not including modern art bullshit in this classification of art). All form of art are memetics and can change the world. Grant Morrison (fucking epic comic writer) practices memetics with his comic book works and Alan Moore write and speaks in great deal about this as well (do some interneting to find awesomeness).

Verbal communication requires the Sender (speaker) to encode the intent of their communication and then transmit it across the channel. The receiver (listener) then unpacks the message, decodes the meaning and intent, then the receiver encodes their response, packages it up, and send it back as feedback to the original sender. Nothing will ever replace this form of communication until we become telepathic as a species.

TL;DR: Memes, as a form of communication, are sent out into the world and you never receive immediate feedback like you do with verbal communication and that is why they will never replace it a the primary form of communicating.
